How this demo handles information

The project enquiry form validates information in your browser. Submission is disabled by default: no enquiry records are stored and no email is automatically sent. The form does not persist your entries in local storage.

When enquiry storage is enabled

The supplied deployment can use Netlify Forms after approval. The site operator must confirm the data controller, lawful basis, purpose, retention period, processors and any international transfers before collecting enquiries. No analytics, advertising pixels or subscriptions are included.

Hosting and external links

The selected hosting provider may process technical request information such as IP addresses in operational logs. Phone, email and Facebook links open services you choose to use; their privacy terms apply. Images are hosted with the website.

Details to complete before launch

Confirm the legal entity and registered contact details, privacy contact, applicable rights process, retention schedule, hosting arrangements and final privacy wording. The supplied business email is Proniks.99ltd@gmail.com; its use as a privacy contact is not confirmed.

For UK data protection rights information, see the Information Commissioner’s Office. This draft does not assert legal compliance.
